event_description: Proclamation of disaster emergency ahead of Hurricane Irene, with heavy rain, flash flooding and high winds expected.
Proclamation of emergency for a winter storm with substantial snow and ice accumulations.
Statewide proclamation of disaster emergency for Hurricane Sandy.
Proclamation of disaster emergency for an ice and snow storm that damaged infrastructure and caused widespread power outages.
Proclamation of disaster emergency for a severe winter weather event with snow and ice accumulation (terminated March 23, 2016).
Proclamation of disaster emergency for severe flash flooding from heavy rainfall on October 20-21, 2016 in Bradford, Centre, Lycoming and Sullivan counties.
Proclamation of disaster emergency for a severe winter weather event with snow and ice accumulation (terminated March 23, 2017).
Proclamation of disaster emergency for Bucks and Montgomery counties after unusually heavy rains from Tropical Storm Allison beginning June 15, 2001.
Proclamation of disaster emergency for a severe winter storm with heavy snow and high winds.
Proclamation of disaster emergency for Crawford, Forest, Mercer, McKean, Potter, Tioga, Venango and Warren counties after unusually heavy rains and tornadoes.
Proclamation of disaster emergency for flooding from heavy rains on September 14 and 15, 2003 and the approach of Hurricane Isabel.
Proclamation of disaster emergency for severe storms, heavy rain, high winds and flooding from Tropical Depression Frances on September 8 and 9, 2004.
Proclamation of disaster emergency for flooding from Tropical Depression Ivan.
Proclamation of disaster emergency for severe storms and flooding.
Proclamation of disaster emergency for severe flooding in 46 counties from heavy rain that began June 23, 2006.
Proclamation of disaster emergency for a winter storm with substantial snow and high winds that began February 5, 2010.
